# html-textview (vendored)

Source copy of [SufficientlySecure/html-textview](https://github.com/SufficientlySecure/html-textview)
at tag `v4.0`, licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE`).

The upstream project is archived and only ever published binaries to JCenter, which
has been shut down. The sources are therefore built as a local Gradle module.
